v0_1_0.multicli: Multi-CLI session browser: sessions from six CLIs in one tree.
v0_1_0.fulltextSearch: Full-text search: a local index over prompts, replies, tool calls and code blocks.
v0_1_0.proxy: API reverse proxy and traffic inspector: inspect request and response bodies, latency and token usage locally.
v0_1_0.editor: Monaco editor and Git diff: side-by-side diffs with syntax highlighting.
v0_1_0.assistant: Desktop assistant: ask questions over past sessions, with cited sources.
v0_1_0.performance: Large-session performance: a 1 GB session opens without freezing the UI.
v0_1_0.updater: In-app updates: delivered through GitHub Releases.
